risk_note: Admin console audit log and export tasks pages (apps/admin; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2 because App.tsx is touched, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Contracts CT-24c / CT-24k (adminListAuditLogs, adminGetAuditLog, adminCreateExport, adminListExports, adminDownloadExport, adminRetryExport; planned, backend not done, developed against the contract with a fake server); no finalized board, logic first. Audit list with filters, paging and states (a failed re-query drops old rows), detail subpage /audit-logs/<id> with a before / after diff, export from the current filters with the export permission; export tasks /exports with dictionary status names, expiry judged against the injected clock at render and before a download, a signed link per download click, retry for failed tasks with per-task dialogs and busy state, 30417 refresh. Known workaround: the data layer accepts only HTTP 200, so the page treats the 202 of adminCreateExport as success (follow-up task). Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/2: 49 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds; test machine verify-fast/7 and browser/5 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1: expiry judged once with Date.now instead of the injected clock; S2: one retry closed another task's dialog), round 2 pass (2 S2 tracked in followups), round 3 pass on the fix for a clock passing expires_at between the first render and the timer effect (same 2 S2)

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1: a Drawer detail was rejected; ruled a fixed subpage; 4 S2), round 2 pass after Codex round 2 (2 S2 carried into the implementation constraints)

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
